summary: Comprehensive backend + UI testing of the 4 new feature sets: Transparency editor (admin publish w/ 100% validation + public reflection + report URL validation), Event Waitlist auto-mode (RSVP fills, waitlist join+dup, auto-promote on RSVP removal), Event Waitlist invite-mode (invited status with token hold, claim-spot token flow, already-claimed state, invalid token 404), RSVP cancel token flow, Add-to-Calendar ICS endpoint (text/calendar), Donor Self-Service manage-link (generic reply, invalid email 400, bogus portal token 410, real monthly-donor portal session returning billing.stripe.com URL and token single-use enforcement). Added /app/backend/tests/test_review_features.py (17 tests, 17/17 PASS after rate-limit tuning). UI smoke tested: Admin Transparency tab publish+validation+'Last published' status, public /transparency shows 82¢ headline + 3 spend rows (no 'Illustrative figures.'), /manage-gift email flow + ?token=bogus + ?done=1 + footer-manage-gift-link, donate-manage-note visible on Monthly, Events page RSVP w/ add-google-calendar + add-apple-calendar links (apple href = /api/events/{id}/calendar.ics), event-waitlist-btn appears once full, waitlist-success shows position. Cleanup done: QA session+user removed, QA events/RSVPs/waitlist/manage-tokens deleted, transparency doc restored to default, staff_notify_email restored to caringsistersclub@gmail.com, 1 real monthly donor preserved.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2853 lines - violates the file-size guideline (<700). Suggest splitting into modules: transparency.py, events.py, donor_manage.py, media.py, admin_donations.py. Low risk, high maintainability win.

_rate_limit shared 'rsvp' bucket for POST /events/{id}/rsvp AND /events/{id}/waitlist at 5/min/IP: a legitimate flow where a user RSVPs, hits capacity-conflict, then is prompted to join waitlist can trip the limit in corner cases (shared counter). Consider either separate buckets or raising to 10/min.

/api/events/{eid}/calendar.ics is public (no event_id secrecy) - any guesser with event id can download the ICS. Acceptable since event listing is already public, but note: it also returns ICS for past-dated events (no date filter), unlike public /events which filters today>=. Minor.

donor_portal() stores Stripe portal configuration id in settings doc keyed by 'stripe_portal_config_{live|test}'. The fallback on InvalidRequestError re-creates and overwrites but if Stripe is temporarily down, the except catches the ORIGINAL InvalidRequestError only (not other types) - a 500 from Stripe will raise 502 (good) but the recovery branch could log the reason explicitly for ops visibility.
AdminTransparency.jsx: PDF upload uses /api/media endpoint - file size/type validation lives server-side only. Consider frontend file-size preflight (e.g., >10MB) to avoid wasted uploads.

Transparency.jsx: transparency-headline uses Math.round(headline) ¢ where headline is the first breakdown row's pct - if an admin reorders breakdown so Programs isn't first, the headline will reflect the first row (not necessarily Programs). Document to admins or always compute from the 'Programs & Services' label.
_claim_state treats missing invite_expires as 'expired' via string comparison with _now_iso() - safe but implicit. Consider explicit None check.
donor_manage_tokens collection lacks a TTL index; expired tokens accumulate forever. Add a MongoDB TTL index on expires_at (converted to date) or periodic cleanup.

seed_data_creation: During tests: 1 QA admin user+session, 3 QA events (deleted), QA RSVPs/waitlist entries @example.com (deleted), 1 QA donor_manage_token (deleted), 1 QA transparency settings doc (deleted after tests per review request). Post-test state verified: 0 QA artefacts remain; staff_notify_email restored to caringsistersclub@gmail.com; transparency returns to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limits to pace: /events/{id}/rsvp and /events/{id}/waitlist share 'rsvp' bucket 5/min/IP; /donor/manage-link 3 per 5 min; /donor/portal 10/min; /events/token/{t} 20/min. The invite-mode flow requires >60s sleep between RSVP+waitlist+new RSVP against the same event. Admin cookie flow: qa_session.py up seeds session_token=qa_tok_123 and blanks staff_notify_email; always call qa_session.py down after. For real-donor portal tests, insert donor_manage_tokens doc manually (kind='request', used=false, expires_at=+1h) and delete afterward. Transparency settings doc at {key:'transparency'} must be deleted after any QA edits so public page shows defaults again.
rca of the issue: No issues found - all features working as spec. One intermittent 429 during initial run of TestWaitlistInvite was due to shared RSVP rate limiter; mitigated by adding 65s sleep at start of test (and documented in context_for_next_testing_agent).
